title: Chicken Pesto Pasta
desc: Chicken, light basil pesto, cherry tomatoes and spinach through pasta. A 20-minute weeknight.

portions.J: 180 g raw chicken, 90 g dry pasta (about 2 cups cooked)
portions.P: 120 g raw chicken, 60 g dry pasta (about 1.3 cups cooked)

steps.title: Pasta on
steps.text: Cook the pasta in well-salted water. Save a mug of pasta water.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Season and cook the chicken in a hot non-stick pan until golden and cooked through. Set aside.

steps.title: Tomatoes and garlic
steps.text: Same pan, cook the tomatoes and garlic until the tomatoes just soften.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Off the heat, add the drained pasta, chicken, pesto, spinach and a splash of pasta water. Toss until glossy and the spinach wilts. Top with parmesan.

notes: Pesto on a hot pan goes dark and bitter. Off the heat keeps it bright.
